items.content_text: Sentra announced a US$150 million investment led by Capital One Ventures, which is to take a board seat, with existing investors Bessemer Venture Partners, Zeev Ventures, Standard Investments, Munich Re Ventures and Key1 Capital taking part. SecurityWeek describes the round as a Series C that takes total funding above US$260 million.

items.title: launch: Sysdig launches Sysdig AI Defense for runtime security of AI agents
items.content_text: Sysdig's newsroom lists a press release dated 2026-11-04 announcing Sysdig AI Defense, a separate offering that applies runtime security to actions taken by AI agents.

items.title: acquisition: CrowdStrike signs definitive agreement to acquire Fiddler AI; deal not yet closed
items.content_text: CrowdStrike announced on 2026-11-03 that it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Fiddler AI. CrowdStrike said Fiddler will be sold as part of its Falcon platform under the name Falcon Observe, that the price is to be paid predominantly in cash with a portion in stock subject to vesting, and that closing is expected in its fourth quarter of fiscal 2027 subject to customary conditions. Financial terms were not disclosed. No completion announcement was found as of 2026-11-20, so Fiddler is recorded as still independent. CrowdStrike is not yet a tracked vendor in this dataset.

items.title: launch: Noma announces next generation of its AI red-teaming engine
items.content_text: In a blog post dated 2026-11-02 Noma described a new version of its red-teaming engine with chained attack techniques, custom goals written in plain language, a check on what agents actually do, presets for use in CI/CD, and results mapped to the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications and MITRE ATLAS. No availability date was given.

items.title: security incident: Cursor discloses data exposure via a provider key and tampered marketplace extension
items.content_text: Disclosed by Cursor on 2026-10-29 and updated on 2026-11-13: an attacker used an access key Cursor had issued to inference provider Fireworks to copy a storage bucket holding mostly 2025 coding-agent traces from sessions without Privacy Mode, some containing credentials. Cursor stated that those credentials gave access to internal tools and that tampered builds of the Claude Code extension (2.1.312 and 2.1.313) were served from its extension marketplace cache for about 11 hours on 2026-10-29 to at most 5,000 users. Cursor stated that agent traces were exposed for fewer than 0.05% of users, API credentials for fewer than 0.01% of customers, that customer code repositories and Privacy Mode data were not affected, and that it moved inference off Fireworks, rotated credentials and rebuilt the marketplace.

items.title: funding: Cohere completes initial close of Series E at a CAD 35.7 billion valuation
items.content_text: Light Reading reported on 2026-10-29 that Cohere had completed the initial close of a Series E round targeting up to CAD 7 billion at a valuation of CAD 35.7 billion, led by Schwarz Group, with Bell Ventures, Bullhound Capital and the Government of Canada as new investors and Inovia Capital, NVIDIA and Prosperity7 Ventures returning. The amount raised at the initial close was not given. The report said annual recurring revenue had grown 165% year on year at the end of the third quarter of 2026 and the company had 300 customers.

items.title: funding: Upwind raises US$400M Series C at a reported US$3.8B valuation
items.content_text: Upwind announced a US$400M Series C led by Bessemer Venture Partners with Canapi Ventures, TCV, Greylock and Salesforce Ventures among participants, bringing total funding to more than US$800M. SecurityWeek reported a US$3.8B valuation.

items.title: vulnerability disclosure: Milvus project publishes six advisories on missing authentication and authorization checks
items.content_text: The Milvus project's advisory list showed six advisories published on 2026-10-28, two rated high and four rated moderate, the latter covering access-control checks on telemetry, import-job, collection-description and statistics interfaces. The two high advisories were read: GHSA-gg6q-4562-83ww states that legacy REST routes on the metrics port authenticated callers but skipped role checks (versions 2.6.10 to before 2.6.25 and 3.0.0 to before 3.0.3; fixed in 2.6.25 and 3.0.3), and GHSA-hr46-v5qw-wr2q states that two streaming gRPC methods on the proxy could be reached without credentials (versions 2.6.2 to 2.6.22 and 3.0.0; fixed in 2.6.23 and 3.0.1). Neither cites observed attacks or mentions Zilliz Cloud. A further moderate advisory published on 2026-09-27 stated that import could bypass collection-level access control. The four moderate advisories of 2026-10-28 were read from the list only.

items.title: launch: IBM launches IBM Quantum Safe suite for post-quantum migration
items.content_text: IBM announced IBM Quantum Safe on 27 October 2026 according to an analyst commentary published the next day; Quantum Computing Report says it was released commercially at IBM's TechXchange conference. The suite groups Quantum Safe Cryptography Manager, Quantum Safe Explorer and Quantum Safe Proxy and builds on Guardium Cryptography Manager from 2025.

items.title: funding: Infisical raises US$40M Series B at a reported US$600M valuation
items.content_text: Infisical announced a US$40 million Series B led by Elad Gil with Y Combinator and Gradient Ventures participating. SecurityWeek reported the valuation as US$600 million and total funding as nearly US$60 million, and said the money would go to product development, hiring and AI agent security.

items.title: launch: Pinecone releases pg_pinecone, an open-source search extension for Postgres data
items.content_text: Pinecone's newsroom lists the launch of pg_pinecone on 27 October 2026, described as open-source search for Postgres data. The licence and its relationship to the managed database were not reviewed.

items.title: certification: Saviynt announces FedRAMP Class D (High) certification
items.content_text: Saviynt announced FedRAMP Class D (High) certification, assessed by a third-party assessment organisation, covering identity governance and administration, privileged access management and application access governance. The vendor says it has held FedRAMP Moderate authorisation since 2019.

items.title: partnership: Tonic.ai and Carahsoft announce public-sector distribution partnership
items.content_text: Tonic.ai announced that Carahsoft will act as its master government aggregator, making Fabricate, Structural and Textual available to US public-sector buyers through Carahsoft's contracts and resellers.

items.title: litigation: US court grants Alibaba a preliminary injunction limited to a lobbying restriction; designation stands
items.content_text: Reported by the South China Morning Post on 29 October 2026: a judge of the US District Court for the Northern District of California granted Alibaba a preliminary injunction against a lobbying restriction tied to its Section 1260H designation, in a lawsuit Alibaba filed on 23 June 2026, and did not decide Alibaba's challenge to the designation itself, which remains in place. The Next Web reported on 5 July 2026, citing Bloomberg, that the court had earlier granted temporary relief on the same restriction.
